title: Recursive gate conditions and indexed conditions
statement: For any finite list $G$ of Boolean circuit gates and any natural number $	ext{len}$, the recursive condition that each gate has at most two distinct arguments, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and each argument of the current gate is less than the current available length (which increases by one at each gate) is equivalent to the conjunction of these local gate conditions for every gate in $G$ and the indexed condition that the argument at position $i$ of $G$ is less than $	ext{len}+i$ for every valid index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite list of gates
